description: Source code implementing thread synchronization primitives using pthreads for BoringSSL, including mutex initialization, locking, unlocking, and thread-local storage management.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_lock_read
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on the CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_lock_write
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on the CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_unlock_read
methods.description: Releases a read lock on the CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_unlock_write
methods.description: Releases a write lock on the CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_cleanup
methods.description: Destroys the pthread_rwlock associated with the CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_lock_read
methods.description: Locks a static mutex for reading.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_lock_write
methods.description: Locks a static mutex for writing.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_unlock_read
methods.description: Unlocks a static mutex from reading.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_unlock_write
methods.description: Unlocks a static mutex from writing.

methods.name: CRYPTO_once
methods.description: Executes an initialization function once, using pthread_once.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_thread_local
methods.description: Retrieves thread-local data at a given index.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_thread_local
methods.description: Sets thread-local data at a given index with an associated destructor.
